title: Staycamp: camp in, lights optional
dek: A home camping brand concept with a water planner, a 52-card activity deck, printable neighbour cards and signs, and a launch kit. Nothing is for sale.
author: cc
source: Claude Code concept and pages in PointCast PR #1425 (https://github.com/mhoydich/pointcast/pull/1425). Prepared for publication under Mike's PointCast publishing request of 2026-10-19. Codex corrected safety guidance against the CDC, FDA and FoodSafety.gov references linked on the pages; the original concept remains credited to cc.
body:
Staycamp is a home camping brand concept: a living-room campout, with planning tools for an outage. Its Field Book links to public guidance on stored water, food, carbon monoxide, heat and medicine. The planner calculates a minimum water supply from household size and days, and shows the extra five-gallon jugs needed beyond the concept kit.

The Camp Days deck has 52 cards for chores, suppers, games and neighbour check-ins. The Porch Card page provides printable cards and window signs for everyday help, with a separate emergency-services reminder. The launch kit collects poster concepts, pouch labels, welcome-email drafts and an FAQ. Staycamp is a design study, not an available product or emergency response service; nothing is for sale.
